revision_note: Protective two-part case (tray + lid) for the Apple Mac mini M4 (2024). Device size from Apple official spec: 127 x 127 mm footprint, 50 mm tall, rounded aluminum cuboid. Case features: rounded corners echoing the device, per-side 0.4 mm clearance, 2.4 mm walls, full rear port band opening, bottom + top vent grille (M4 intakes air from the bottom perimeter), four feet, and a lid with a skirt overlapping the tray. Sizes are chosen automatically from the official dimensions.
